title: #659 write-once assignment-ledger gate pass receipt
description: Written exclusively by the assignment gate after every closed check passes against the exact finalized blind bundle. The embedded ledger (validated separately against judge_assignment_ledger.schema.json by the gate on both write and read) carries the four bundle hash bindings; delivery consumes only this receipt, never a mutable external ledger path. A failed verification writes nothing.

ledger.description: The exact accepted ledger value; ledger_sha256 is the sha256 of the accepted ledger file's exact bytes as read.
